description: grant the test user the identity-wide ego.table.read/write/update permissions. These gate the /dsns/{dsn}/tables/{table}/rows route itself (Permissions() in routes.go) and are a coarse, all-tables 'may reach this endpoint at all' check -- a completely separate mechanism from the per-table table_perms grants (also spelled ego.table.read/write/etc, but checked by Authorized() against a specific table) exercised by the rest of this test group. Without this grant, every request below would be rejected here, before ever reaching the dsns_auth/table_perms logic under test.
